historical_validation_role: Previously observed development diagnostics. No model or hyperparameter is selected using these results.
prior_test_data_policy: Seeds 1300, 1301, 1302 and all earlier test batches are excluded from fitting and confirmation.

fit.training_objective: mean complete-trajectory speed MSE, equal target means within each seed and equal seed means, plus 0.01 times mean squared normalized departure from the baseline parameters

objectives.derivative: Conditional one-step acceleration residual from the original _longitudinal_design; measured speeds before and after exceed 0.1 m/s and have the same sign; normalized by 1 m/s^2.
objectives.rollout: Complete predicted speed residual from the published rollout fitter; normalized by 1 m/s.
objectives.shared: Same C3 ownership, complete training trajectories, trajectory target/seed weights, five parameter bounds, initial values, regularization, optimizer and no pitch.

fit_freeze_rule: Fit both predefined objectives once. Both optimizers must converge. Publish both parameters and diagnostic validation results before new collection. No retuning or model selection.

window.initial_state: Measured vehicle state at probe origin
window.throttle_filter_state: Computed from all recorded commands before the origin using each frozen model throttle lag
window.future_inputs: Identical recorded command sequence for all models

exclusions: probe entry differs from target by more than 0.25 m/s
coverage: Every seed must retain all eight unique balanced conditions. There are no reserve seeds.
primary: 3 s speed MSE, equal condition means within each seed and equal seed means; rollout minus derivative
secondary: history effect on signed 1 s acceleration prediction errors
conditional training objective and full speed rollout errors
collection_policy: Preserve every full approach and attempt. Stop if a completed seed fails coverage. An infrastructure interruption before metrics inspection permits one complete same-seed replay after preserving the failed run. Use one complete realization per seed.
limitations: Historical validation has already been inspected.
Three test seed batches provide pilot uncertainty.
The new test covers one vehicle and one map.
This experiment isolates fitting objective within the five-parameter model family.
No human parameters or default presets are changed.
The original derivative objective excludes standstill and sign changes. The rollout objective includes complete trajectories. These masks are part of the published objective comparison.
